retrieved.title: Ticketing System integration with Zoom failing
retrieved.description: [TCK-99417] Ticket raised because the Ticketing System integration with Zoom has stopped syncing and shows repeated authentication failures. This is impacting daily work.
retrieved.resolution: The Zoom API credentials used by Ticketing System had expired; rotated the token, stored it in the secrets manager, and re-enabled the sync job.

retrieved.title: Cannot mount \\fs02\marketing on new machines
retrieved.description: [TCK-15852] Ticket raised because recently provisioned machines fail to map the file share \\fs02\marketing, though existing machines connect fine. This is impacting daily work.
retrieved.resolution: The new machines were missing the updated SMB protocol setting required by \\fs02\marketing; pushed the correct client configuration via policy and the share mapped successfully.

retrieved.title: Ticketing System throwing errors after latest deploy
retrieved.description: [TCK-98029] Reported by the Ahmedabad Office team: immediately after the most recent Ticketing System release, users are seeing unexpected errors on pages that worked yesterday. Please investigate and resolve.
retrieved.resolution: A missed database migration accompanied the Ticketing System deploy; ran the pending migration and redeployed, and the post-release errors cleared.
